preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
Each string s must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each string s must consist only of lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(len(p) * count for p, count in substrings.items()))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the product of the length of each substring p and its count in the string s.
